what: Press the menu button and a panel tilted −4° comes down from the top of the screen in .6s, and the menu lines rise from 70% below at .1s intervals. On close it rewinds the same path 1.6x faster

options.drop: Panel start position (% of panel height), default −110 — the brand original uses −150
options.dur: Panel duration (seconds), default .6 — original brand uses .75
options.ease: Panel curve, default power3.out — the brand original uses elastic.out(1, 1.25)
options.linkFrom: Menu row start position (row height %), default 70 — the original is 100
options.linkFade: when off, menu lines are not blurred, they only rise from under a mask (overflow hidden)
options.linkAt: When the menu row appears at panel start (seconds, negative means earlier), default .15 — −.1 in the original of a site
options.rewind: Rewind speed on close, default 1.6 — brand original is 1

from.where: shared.js .menu-btn·.m-menu (phone menu — original Menu part: the panel is flat and only the back plate is tilted −6°, panel yPercent −150→0 .75s elastic.out(1, 1.25), lines rise from 100% below the mask to 0 at .1s intervals, .5s power2.inOut, and so on <At −.1, the close button autoAlpha .5s >to −.1, and closing rewinds at the same speed)
